titles: The Body That Is The Curriculum
essence: Three years of theory as armour, until Briar sat in the back row and grinned once. Now she teaches that arousal is not shame but scripture, by embodying every lesson in front of fourteen students.
note:
THE PORNY PROFESSOR. Eden's younger sister, teaching the system her older sister built the first step of, from a syllabus of Siren's novels, Sapphira and Mercedes's films, and Briar bending her over the desk in front of the class to demonstrate brat-top and eager receiver. SHE TEACHES FROM THE RECEIVING POSITION — every woman in that room came out of a place where a body got demonstrated ON, and the first thing Quinn shows them is a woman putting her own on the table on purpose and it staying hers the whole time.

SHE GOES COMMANDO. Officially so Briar has less to remove. Also the breeze. Also, and mostly, because she likes being the only person in the building who knows.
